description: React component for managing and displaying availability windows for doctors and ICU rooms, including fetches to backend API endpoints, form handling, inline editing, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Minimal JSON fetch helper to perform API requests and handle responses.

methods.name: fetchDoctors
methods.description: Fetches list of doctors from backend API.

methods.name: fetchICUs
methods.description: Fetches list of ICU rooms from backend API.

methods.name: fetchAvailabilities
methods.description: Fetches list of availability windows from backend API.

methods.name: createAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Creates a new availability window via API.

methods.name: updateAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Updates an existing availability window via API.

methods.name: deleteAvailabilityApi
methods.description: Deletes an availability window via API.
